title: The World's Ugliest Animal Photo Is a Dead Fish

scenes.text: The world's ugliest animal is a lie.
The famous blobfish photo shows a dead fish, hauled up from the deep.
It lives roughly 600 to 1,200 meters down, under more than 100 times surface pressure.
That pressure holds its body in shape. It has no swim bladder, because the gas would be crushed.
Pulled to the surface, it melts into a blob.
Underwater, a live blobfish looks like a fairly ordinary fish.

description:
The world's ugliest animal is a lie.
The blobfish in the famous photo was a dead specimen, damaged by being hauled up from the deep. A live one looks like a fairly ordinary fish.
Had you seen the real photo before? Comment below.
first_comment: The blobfish was voted the world's ugliest animal in 2013 using that photo. Should the title go to a different animal?
